structured_output.summary: Fixed. In src/ui/keycap-legend.ts, setPowerUp now tracks its state in a `powerUpOn` flag and returns early when the value hasn't changed. This is the same pattern setFirstLap already uses. Before the fix, race-ui's per-frame `legend.setPowerUp(view.pickups !== undefined)` ran `panel.insertBefore(powerUp, pause)` on every sync, which removed and re-inserted the SPACE · POWER-UP item every frame on pickup tracks. Now an unchanged frame touches no DOM. Visible behaviour is the same: the item is still inserted before PAUSE when pickups appear and removed when they don't. New test tests/ui/power-up-legend-idle.test.ts: (1) the verifier's MutationObserver test. It failed before the fix with two childList records on `ui-keys__panel` and passes after. (2) A check that the legend still reads STEER, GAS, BRAKE, POWER-UP, PAUSE after repeated pickup syncs and drops POWER-UP after a reset to a view without pickups. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes (115 files, 752 tests).
